chunks: And whatever is in it from Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Siyābah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Siyābah.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, the author’s immediate source in the chain
key_terms.الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ: Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Siyābah, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.الْوَشَّاءِ: al-Washshāʾ, an identifying epithet within the sanad/isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Siyābah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Siyābah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission and preserving the source chain for hadith scholarship.
